mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 39 degrees under overcast skies at Harriet Park with a Waning Gibbous moon visible in the early morning sky.
In city news, please remember that winter parking rules start November 20 to help with snow removal, and the Verona Senior Center will be closed for the Thanksgiving holiday on November 26 and 27.

There is plenty to do with the Main Street Trick-Or-Treat happening today, plus live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead, the Dane County Farmers' Market returns tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
Looking at recent police activity, on October 25, officers located a driver at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue who was arrested for an O W I offence.
Treat yourself to today's flavor of the day, which is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
